description: opensync-lab pods as GRE parents on their 5 GHz radio (spec 8.6, 9; the Pis' adapter-B shape of V54): opensync-lab-hwsim-6.6.1-gre-v1 with a second radio. The 5 GHz radio carries the pod's uplink station bhaul-sta-50 (the pod's) and the parent AP b-ap-50 (EMOSA's), configured by that radio's own M2: its backhaul BSS is the parent AP, not Multi-AP, no bridge, broadcasting its SSID as the Pis' profile does, its Inet row the pod's underlay. EMOSA writes no channel or ht_mode on the 5 GHz radio, which follows the station. The 2.4 GHz radio keeps the fronthaul and its fronthaul slots; its M2's backhaul BSS has no slot there and is left out.
